# [ShadowClaw Template](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw-template/)

> Starter template for publishing a static site with ShadowClaw as the build engine. Content lives in `pages/main/`; the included GitHub Actions workflow builds and deploys to GitHub Pages.

## Docs

- [README](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw-template/README.md): How the template works and local development
- [AGENTS.md](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw-template/AGENTS.md): Conventions for AI agents working on a template site
